[[Heavy Chain Bracers]],

[[Deep-Thread Shawl]] | previous = [[The Frostmane War]] }} == Objectives == Slay Battlemaster Ubukaz deep within Frostmane Hollow for Mountaineer Granitebeard at the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh. * [[Battlemaster Ubukaz]] slain == Description == My scouts have confirmed the location of a cave to the south west. It is called Frostmane Hollow, some de-facto capital for all of the troll kind in Dun Morogh. If we want to ever put a halt to this threat, we will need to root it out, from deep inside. Rumor has it that their leader is one called Battlemaster Ubukaz, some revered Frostmane fighter who now calls his warriors to battle. I want you to find him, and bring justice for Ironforge. I would advise you to bring reinforcements, there is no telling just how many enemies you may find in that cave. ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Heavy Chain Bracers]] * [[Sash of Illumination]] * [[Deep-Thread Shawl]] You will also receive: * 1200 XP == Progress == Be prepared for anything , the Frostmane are a cunning foe. == Completion == So, Ubukaz has been slain? I cannot believe my ears, I have no doubt there will be a another troll that shall rise to be chieftain, but for these coming days, peace shall be had in Dun Morogh. Until their infighting is over, we have time to celebrate! ==Progression== #{{questlong|Alliance|13|The Frostmane War}} #{{questlong|Alliance|16D|Chieftain Ubukaz}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.1|note=Added.}}
